title: Bret vs. Owen: the Hart family feud
summary: Owen refuses to remain in his older brother’s shadow. A broken partnership leads to a WrestleMania upset and a championship cage match.

chapters.title: The partnership falls apart
chapters.result: The Harts lose their tag-title challenge; Owen turns on Bret.
chapters.context: Owen blames his brother after an injury ends the match.

chapters.title: Owen defeats Bret
chapters.result: Owen wins the brothers’ singles match.
chapters.context: Bret loses to Owen before winning the WWF championship later that night.

chapters.title: Bret retains inside the cage
chapters.result: Bret defeats Owen in a WWF Championship Steel Cage Match.
chapters.context: The family feud reaches its best-known championship confrontation.
